title: SourceHandle.v1
description: The structured form of the ctx:// source handle that every artifact carries back to its origin. The canonical string is also stored on the artifact as `source_handle`; this object is the parsed, validated, scope-aware decomposition of it. Global handles use ctx://public/...; tenant handles use ctx://tenant/<tenant_id>/... so a tenant_private handle can never collide with a global_public one.
